veranderings.rede: A compound is written as one word under the AWS; no vowel clash or other ground calls for a hyphen here.

veranderings.voor: Die ander aande van die week is die skottelgoed sy suster se beurt.
veranderings.na: Op die ander aande van die week is dit sy suster se beurt om die skottelgoed te was.
veranderings.rede: The sentence makes 'die skottelgoed' the subject of 'is ... se beurt', which is loose and wooden; the full construction says the same thing clearly.

veranderings.voor: so hy trek 'n kring om die woord breuke
veranderings.na: daarom trek hy 'n kring om die woord "breuke"
veranderings.rede: 'so hy trek' copies English word order; Afrikaans needs the verb second after the linking word, and a word cited as a word goes in quotation marks, as 'breuke, een uur' already does later.

veranderings.voor: Woensdagaand is nou te vol vir skottelgoed ook.
veranderings.na: Woensdagaand is nou ook te vol vir skottelgoed.
veranderings.rede: Sentence-final 'ook' follows English order; in Afrikaans 'ook' stands before the part it qualifies.

veranderings.voor: Die laaste paragraaf is kort en sy handskrif
veranderings.na: Die laaste paragraaf is kort, en sy handskrif
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: a comma before 'en' when it joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: stuur meneer Botha hom op die veld
veranderings.na: stuur meneer Botha hom die veld in
veranderings.rede: A player is sent 'die veld in' in natural Afrikaans; 'op die veld stuur' reads as a translation of 'send onto the field'.
